definitions.short: a falling off , i.e. chaff ; also something pendulous , i.e. a flap
definitions.full: H4651. mappal [ מַמָּל ] noun masculine Job 41:15 refuse, hanging parts ; — 1 fallings, refuse , construct בַּר מַמַּל Amos 8:6 the refuse of wheat. 2 plural construct בְשָׂרוֺ מַמְּלֵי Job 41:15 the hanging (falling, drooping) parts of his flesh (of crocodile).
